lines.say: What happened here?
lines.show: What happened here?

lines.say: And here? And here?
lines.show: And here? And here?

lines.say: Every light on this map is a place in the story of Islam.
lines.show: Every light on this map is a place in the story of Islam.

lines.say: This is the Place map at Islam dot Museum: a free, online museum of Islam, that you can walk into from anywhere.
lines.show: This is the Place map at islam.museum: a free, online museum of Islam that you can walk into from anywhere.

lines.say: It opens on the whole world. Three thousand, eight hundred and seventy-five places, in twelve regions.
lines.show: It opens on the whole world. 3,875 places, in twelve regions.

lines.say: Press play, and time begins to move. Year by year, the map lights up wherever history was being written.
lines.show: Press play, and time begins to move. Year by year, the map lights up wherever history was being written.

lines.say: Choose a region.
lines.show: Choose a region.

lines.say: Then a place. Medina.
lines.show: Then a place. Medina.

lines.say: Around it, six hundred and ninety-three linked records: the people who lived here, and the events that took place here.
lines.show: Around it, 693 linked records: the people who lived here, and the events that took place here.

lines.say: Choose a name, and the map turns around that life. Abu Bakr as-Siddeeq: born in Mecca, died in Medina.
lines.show: Choose a name, and the map turns around that life. Abu Bakr al-Siddiq: born in Mecca, died in Medina.

lines.say: Open the entry to read the full page, with its dates and its sources.
lines.show: Open the entry to read the full page, with its dates and its sources.

lines.say: Or simply search. Cordoba. Ibn Rushd, the Great Mosque: a whole world around one city.
lines.show: Or simply search. Cordoba. Ibn Rushd, the Great Mosque: a whole world around one city.

lines.say: Because history is not a list. It is a web of people, places and moments. And here, you can walk through it.
lines.show: Because history is not a list. It is a web of people, places and moments. And here, you can walk through it.

lines.say: And the map is only one door.
lines.show: And the map is only one door.

lines.say: In the Connections explorer, any name becomes a constellation: one entry at the centre, and everything it touches around it.
lines.show: In the Connections explorer, any name becomes a constellation: one entry at the centre, and everything it touches around it.

lines.say: You can walk the museum in three dimensions: a Grand Hall, with nine wings.
lines.show: You can walk the museum in three dimensions: a Grand Hall, with nine wings.

lines.say: Or take the Grand Tour: fourteen centuries, in forty stops.
lines.show: Or take the Grand Tour: fourteen centuries, in forty stops.

lines.say: Follow one life on the Timeline Explorer. Read the Quran and the hadeeth. Meet the Companions. Trace an invention. There is even a wing for children.
lines.show: Follow one life on the Timeline Explorer. Read the Qur'an and the hadith. Meet the Companions. Trace an invention. There is even a wing for children.

lines.say: More than fifty explorers and browsers. More than sixty-three thousand records. In Arabic, English and Urdu. And it is still growing.
lines.show: More than fifty explorers and browsers. More than 63,000 records. In Arabic, English and Urdu. And it is still growing.

lines.say: It is a whole new world: a new way to discover Islam that, we believe, has never existed before.
lines.show: It is a whole new world: a new way to discover Islam that, we believe, has never existed before.

lines.say: Come in. Stay as long as you like. And enjoy it.
lines.show: Come in. Stay as long as you like. And enjoy it.

lines.say: Islam dot Museum. Free, with no ads, forever.
lines.show: islam.museum. Free, with no ads, forever.
